=== head shop/server.ts
import { helper } from "./util";
import type { Options } from "./types";

const DEFAULT_PORT = 8080;

/** A shop server. */
export class Server {
	/** Where it listens. */
	readonly port: number = DEFAULT_PORT;
	private started = false;
	#secret = 1;

	constructor(public host: string, options?: Options) {}

	// Starts listening.
	start(block = true): void {
		this.started = block;
	}

	async stop(timeout?: number) {
		return helper(timeout);
	}

	/** Only for tests. */
	private reset() {}

	get address(): string {
		return `${this.host}:${this.port}`;
	}
}

export function makeServer(host: string, port = DEFAULT_PORT): Server {
	return new Server(host);
}

export function unlisted() {}

=== head shop/util.ts
import { other } from "./far/away";

export function helper(timeout?: number) {
	return other(timeout);
}

export const table = {
	size: 1,
	loaded: other(),
};

export function overloaded(key: number): number;
export function overloaded(key: string): string;
export function overloaded(key: any): any {
	return key;
}

function hidden() {}
